cost: Ordinary closed scanning O(B); repeated missing closer searches O(B²). Returned metadata O(F+U), bodies borrowed. i32 depth unchecked overflow on unbounded input.
description: Byte scanner returns borrowed formula bodies in order plus unterminated opener records. Skips comments/escapes/closed verbatim. Dollar closers skip comments and escapes, inline also tracks signed depth and paragraph boundary. Bracket/environment closers are first literal match. Unmatched openers recover by advancing past opening syntax.
forward: Byte scanner returns borrowed formula bodies in order plus unterminated opener records. Skips comments/escapes/closed verbatim. Dollar closers skip comments and escapes, inline also tracks signed depth and paragraph boundary. Bracket/environment closers are first literal match. Unmatched openers recover by advancing past opening syntax.
inverse: Compatible documents contain arbitrary ignored text constrained by byte offsets and scanner state. Delimiter metadata constrains spellings but cannot recover prose, comments or preambles. Empty result admits empty/prose/comment-only input.

Escaped dollar cannot open; positive brace depth excludes inline close; blank lines stop inline search. Bracket/environment matching is not nested TeX parsing. Unclosed verbatim may resume internal scanning.
limitations: Partial source-derived model and finite synthetic checks
No universal proof or executable percentage surrogate
No live corpus, frozen VMM, teacher/API, training or GPU execution
state: tex[f.start..f.start+f.body.len()]==f.body; offsets are UTF-8 bytes, body starts for Formula but opener for bad. Returned bodies ordered; empty input empty vectors.
